_comment: Hand-maintained anchor facts for slow-moving figures a model can otherwise get wrong even with search grounding (stale cached pages, mixed preview/announcement results). Soft cross-check only — update 'asOf' and 'value' whenever a fact genuinely changes, e.g. after a confirmed RBI MPC decision. Not a substitute for real verification, just a known-good anchor to weigh noisy search results against.

facts.note: Confirmed as of 2026-08-03. The RBI MPC decides the repo rate only at scheduled meeting announcements — do not report a rate change as already decided unless a source clearly post-dates the actual announcement, not just a meeting preview or analyst expectation.
